Algorithm:
Active A* bridge-marker overlay toggle. AStar_main_loop calls this only when Pathfinder+0x3C urgency is nonzero; normal A* success/failure tails call it again, so the XOR overlay is search-scoped. Reads the searcher's current packed cell (Foot vtable+0x1B8), then FacingClass::Current(searcher+0x388). Probe dir = (((facing_dword >> 12)+1)>>1)&7; adds signed-i16 g_DirectionOffsets[dir]. This is current body facing, not RNG/timer entropy.

Peer selection:
At the probe Cell, choose Cell+0xE8 only when flags+0x140 has 0x100 and (abs(signed Cell+0x11B - signed current Cell+0x11B)>3 or searcher+0x8C!=0); otherwise Cell+0xE4. If that head is null, call FindNearbyBridgePeer(probe, signed probe level + (deck?4:0)); only the returned node and its Object+0x30 suffix are processed. Require Foot-derived Object+0x14 bit 0x04 and WhatAmI 1 (Unit) or 0xF (Infantry). Urgency 2 bypasses peer type/speed/path-start gates. Otherwise skip same type; require signed searcher TechnoType+0x678 Speed > peer Speed and Map::Is_Cell_In_Playfield(peer+0x558,1). If urgency 1 finds no processable peer, clear urgency to 0 and return before marking; urgency 2 continues.

Path replay:
Anchor at peer+0x558, directions at peer+0x5E0. Unit requires first 2 entries present; Infantry first 3. Replay up to 24 entries in order until -1. Directions 0..7 add signed-i16 direction offsets. Direction 8 uses signed Cell+0x116 tube index: -1 yields packed (0,0), otherwise g_TubeArray[index]+0x28. Toggle destination Cell+0x140 bit 0x40000 once per replay visit (duplicate visits cancel by parity).

Occupation phase:
Scan probe-centered 5x5 with outer dx=-2..2, inner dy=-2..2, packed-i16 arithmetic and no playfield clamp. Any nonzero full ground Cell+0x124 byte toggles Cell+0x140 bit 0x40000 except the searcher's original current cell. Then toggle the probe center unconditionally. Thus an occupied normal probe center toggles twice/net unchanged; unoccupied center once. The A* edge-cost reader at 0x004299AA multiplies marked destination cost by float 4.0 (0x007E37BC = 00 00 80 40).

Reachability:
Active path is Drive/Walk Process_Movement -> FootClass::Find_Path -> FootClass::Run_AStar -> AStar_pathfind_search -> AStar_main_loop -> this function. Drive and Walk vtable receivers and stock MTNK/E1 INI locomotors were verified.
